topics.topic: Whether OperationBinding inputs and outputs use tuples or lists, and how the note should reflect that choice
questions: Must the note say that inputs and outputs are tuples of ports, or must the OperationBinding model fields change from tuple[Port, ...] to lists?

quotes: record_change: [DETERMINISM_OR_ORDERING] A content record is written with its order-free lists sorted, never in the order a caller submitted them: ports by direction and then by name, flow nodes by node_id, flow edges by to_node, then to_port, then from_node, then from_port, flow constants by to_node and then by to_port, each compared as text by Unicode code point, so equal content submitted in another order is the same record with the same lists; an OperationBinding writes its inputs and its outputs, each a list of ports of one direction, each sorted by name compared the same way, the name order A08 checks a proposal's ports in; every read returns those lists in that order, and every other list, and every JSON value, keeps its order.

judgement.why: The note requires OperationBinding inputs and outputs to be lists, while the exact model surface requires both fields to hold tuples, so satisfying the note would violate the model fields.
judgement.failure: a contradiction needs two quotes found verbatim in the texts

author_guidance: Before editing, identify the decision's owning state from the phase purpose, question_scope and layer obligations, then choose a disposition for each topic that awaits one.
fixed: repair a decision the owning state must make; do not add later-layer implementation choices merely to close a topic. Record the fix commit and review the changed text once.

carried: name the receiving layer and use --what to preserve the choice, its options and consequences, and the required guarantee every option must keep. Decide any guarantee owned here before carrying its execution onward.
accepted: explain why the remaining choice is permitted. Bring an unresolved product choice to the owner with its options and consequences; absence of a quoted requirement does not decide it.
contradiction and standard_violation take no disposition: repair the offending text in its owning state and review the change. Deterministic transition findings must also close through their checks.
